source_bundle.completion_guard: The daily-index date must strictly precede the bundle freeze date in America/New_York; strict header, Last Data Received, separator, reported-row count, and exact case-sensitive 8-K parsing fail closed.

implementation.physical_evidence: Every bundle logical locator resolves portably to a persisted member whose physical byte SHA-256 matches its EvidenceRecord; raw-byte tampering is rejected.
implementation.stable_rows: Source-row hashes bind the parsed SEC row and original line number, excluding retrieval and mapping metadata so harmless refetches cannot create false longitudinal identity changes.
implementation.forward_mapping: Research security/listing identities derive deterministically from CIK, ticker, and MIC; mappings become effective at the association artifact retrieval time and explicitly retain the issuer-versus-security limitation.
implementation.calendar: The evidence-bound EDGAR clock uses America/New_York, the official 06:00-22:00 filing window, and the complete 2026 closure table frozen from the SEC calendar.
implementation.publication: Source members publish before an immutable bundle manifest. The universe ledger is lock-protected and atomically replaced, then strictly reloaded and cross-validated before an immutable envelope publishes. Ledger and envelope form a recoverable staged publication and do not claim cross-file atomicity.
implementation.idempotency: Source-path, ledger, and envelope locks serialize conflict checks; exact completed retries return duplicate, while concurrency, path collision, semantic conflict, and crash recovery fail closed or resume safely.
